message.content:
Let  
\(I = \int 3*exp(x)*sin(x) dx\).

Factor out the constant:

\[
I = 3*\int exp(x)*sin(x) dx
\]

Use integration by parts or the known formula:

\[
\int exp(x)*sin(x) dx = \frac{1}{2}*exp(x)*sin(x) - \frac{1}{2}*exp(x)*cos(x)
\]

Therefore,

\[
I = 3*\left(\frac{1}{2}*exp(x)*sin(x) - \frac{1}{2}*exp(x)*cos(x)\right) + C
\]

\[
I = \frac{3}{2}*exp(x)*sin(x) - \frac{3}{2}*exp(x)*cos(x) + C
\]

<answer>\frac{3}{2}*exp(x)*sin(x) - \frac{3}{2}*exp(x)*cos(x) + C</answer>
